# Check how memoize works when used as @memoize vs @memoize()
import sys
mods_to_remove = [k for k in sys.modules if k.startswith('funcy')]
for m in mods_to_remove:
    del sys.modules[m]

from funcy.calc import memoize, SkipMemoization

# When used as @memoize (no parens)
@memoize
def f1(x):
    return x * 2

print("f1 type:", type(f1))
print("f1 has skip:", hasattr(f1, 'skip'))
print("f1.skip:", f1.skip if hasattr(f1, 'skip') else "N/A")
print("f1 has invalidate:", hasattr(f1, 'invalidate'))
print("f1 has invalidate_all:", hasattr(f1, 'invalidate_all'))
print("f1 has memory:", hasattr(f1, 'memory'))
